user_saw: Gateway memory grew while an attached managed browser tab kept sending background POST requests.
summary: The fix replaces permanent Playwright network listeners with a 500-entry metadata log built from the existing CDP stream.
reasoning: The fix's comparison runs tie the memory growth to Playwright retaining request objects and their POST buffers despite the browser log's 500-entry cap. I verified that the permanent listeners and cached browser connection were already present at the July 1 history boundary, before the session manager split. The available history does not show when the listeners were introduced or establish that a later Playwright update changed retention behavior.
